Now it's most world famous climbing areas: Arco, Crete, Kalymnos, Geyikbairi, Thailand, Sicily, Bishop, Siurana, Frankenjura and many more...

Find a sector you’re interested in, check out the stats on route, view the trail lines, read and post the comments.

An interactive map will help you build a car or pedestrian route to the area, find a path to the sector, then find a multi-pitch start or a bouldering rock in the woods. 

You can leave comments, vote for a route rating or for an alternative "public" grade. You can log your Ascents and see your friends activity. 

to communicate with your climbing mates there is a messaging system in the app. Just find your friend by name or email and tap the chat button.

The application can work offline, without Internet access, just make sure you downloaded sectors or whole areas you need in advance. You can download them all at once (on the "App Guides" tab of the main menu) or manually, sector by sector. And make sure your device’s battery has enough power to keep you on track as long as you need it! 

Happy onsights!
